g.text: Chronological benchmark history · logarithmic latency scale · hover points for details

circle.title: 1. session-path: 17450 ms; 12 modules / 958 decls; shared import; declarations routed through Session and IO.Ref
2. module-path: 16326 ms; 12 modules / 958 decls; shared import; direct module pretty printing
3. two-import-waves: 29881 ms; 64 modules / 982 decls; two 32-module processes and imports
4. single-import-wave: 15278 ms; 64 modules / 982 decls; one process and import for the same modules
5. pp-jobs-1: 15295 ms; 64 modules / 982 decls; single import; one pretty-print task
6. pp-jobs-2: 14799 ms; 64 modules / 982 decls; single import; two pretty-print tasks
7. pp-jobs-4: 14100 ms; 64 modules / 982 decls; single import; four pretty-print tasks
8. pp-jobs-8: 14009 ms; 64 modules / 982 decls; single import; eight pretty-print tasks
9. root-reread-bundle: 24482 ms; 1 modules / 13 decls; Fixture root; rebuild bundle by rereading every module sidecar
10. root-single-pass: 9210 ms; 1 modules / 13 decls; Fixture root; fill bundle during the PP pass
11. pp-v3-names: 17630 ms; 12 modules / 958 decls; first cold build through the pp command and leanreach-pp sidecars
12. shared-import-boundary: 15148 ms; 12 modules / 958 decls; warm-filesystem control; private import routed through Runtime
13. query-private-import: 16811 ms; 7 modules / 12 decls; first dependency query; private olean level
14. query-server-import: 13647 ms; 7 modules / 12 decls; first dependency query; server olean level; identical JSON and sidecars
15. query-server-leak: 13001 ms; 7 modules / 12 decls; first dependency query; persistent process-lifetime environment
16. private-body-module: 1232 ms; 1 modules / 27 decls; private-level import; public definitions retain bodies through private constants
17. server-private-overlay: 1150 ms; 1 modules / 27 decls; server import plus module-local private constants; same complete declarations
18. mathlib-resume: 762600 ms; 8250 modules / 375372 decls; resumed from module sidecars; completed every remaining module and checkpointed before bundle assembly
19. mathlib-bundle-assembly: 45885 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; rebuild deduplicated catalog and assemble existing sidecars into the root bundle
20. mathlib-bundle-hit: 3 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; validated root marker and loaded the complete bundle without scanning module sidecars
21. mathlib-full-cold: 1377105 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; deleted every PP sidecar and root bundle; rebuilt with the packaged executable in 22m57.1s
22. mathlib-full-cold-overlap: 1000558 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; cold PP cache with warm filesystem; overlapped sidecar scan and root import; rebuilt in 16m40.6s
23. first-query-root-bundle: 39299 ms; 9978 modules / 5 decls; new process immediately after the full PP rebuild; root bundle and index pages were cold
24. first-query-module-sidecars: 25145 ms; 9978 modules / 2 decls; new process after removing the root bundle; cold index pages still dominate
25. mathlib-marker-hit: 15 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; internal elapsed time; small root marker returns before loading the catalog
26. cache-command-marker-hit: 5 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; internal elapsed time after restoring the cache CLI boundary
27. compact-catalog-build: 25974 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; reused module fragments; catalog shrank 25.8% from 167387480 to 124277768 bytes
28. session-index-decoupled: 6 ms; 9978 modules / 2 decls; internal cached query elapsed time; Session no longer owns dependency planning
29. query-shards-build-sequential: 64862 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; wall time; sequential ranking and 16 text shards
30. query-shards-build-parallel: 29621 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; wall time; four ranking tasks and 1024 on-demand shards
31. exact-query-shard: 115 ms; 9978 modules / 5 decls; median packaged-process wall time across three distinct exact queries; 22ms median internal
32. leaf-query-shards-build: 34663 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; wall time; 1024 shards keyed by declaration leaf names
33. unique-short-query: 117 ms; 9978 modules / 5 decls; median packaged-process wall time; unique leaf resolves without the catalog
34. ambiguous-short-query: 117 ms; 9978 modules / 0 decls; median packaged-process wall time; ambiguity is reported from one shard
35. trivial-relation-fast-path: 28851 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; wall time; skip ranking context for empty and singleton relations
36. query-module-dictionary: 28290 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; wall time; per-shard module IDs reduced query cache size by 36.9%
37. dictionary-query-hit: 113 ms; 9978 modules / 5 decls; median packaged-process wall time; 10ms median internal across three queries
38. single-module-cold-pp: 94034 ms; 1 modules / 134 decls; cold native cache build; full environment import dominates
39. single-module-warm-pp: 14490 ms; 1 modules / 134 decls; warm import probe; pretty-printing itself took 0.56s
40. combined-root-first-plan: 101360 ms; 2 modules / 0 decls; first Tests.Fixture plus Mathlib query-plan materialization
41. combined-root-pp-reuse: 1690 ms; 2 modules / 0 decls; rebuild root marker while reusing completed Mathlib PP view
42. incremental-local-pp: 14557 ms; 2 modules / 16 decls; rebuild one local module without importing the separate Mathlib root
43. local-query-overlay: 359 ms; 2 modules / 16 decls; build local declarations and cross-layer reverse edges over cached Mathlib
44. auto-root-incremental-cache: 8344 ms; 16 modules / 120 decls; native cache for current local modules over cached Mathlib
45. auto-root-marker-hit: 35 ms; 16 modules / 2597 decls; refresh built roots and validate completed PP and query caches
46. auto-root-exact-query: 12 ms; 16 modules / 5 decls; internal elapsed time for a fresh process using persisted roots and root stamps
47. auto-root-leaf-search: 11 ms; 16 modules / 10 decls; internal elapsed time for a fresh process using persisted roots and root stamps
48. packaged-distinct-query-wall: 116 ms; 16 modules / 5 decls; median wall time across five distinct declarations; Windows loads 250 MB of runtime DLLs
49. private-proof-fragments: 273000 ms; 8265 modules / 375372 decls; one-time migration from server signatures to private theorem bodies
50. proof-rank-shards-naive: 168342 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; full proof graph with graph priors recomputed for every edge
51. proof-rank-shards-cached-prior: 34725 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; precompute each candidate prior once and persist it with relations
52. rank-overlay-refresh: 8249 ms; 16 modules / 2597 decls; refresh local PP and rank overlay after rebuilding LeanReach
53. rank-distinct-query: 22 ms; 16 modules / 10 decls; median internal elapsed across ten distinct cross-domain declarations
54. rank-distinct-query-wall: 139 ms; 16 modules / 10 decls; median new-process wall time across ten distinct cross-domain declarations
55. mathlib-full-cache-overlapped: 957704 ms; 9978 modules / 375372 decls; isolated full dependency query and PP cache with root import overlapped
56. signature-memo-baseline: 28496 ms; 96 modules / 9815 decls; warm PP rebuild before module-local signature memoization
57. signature-memo: 27890 ms; 96 modules / 9815 decls; warm PP rebuild with byte-identical module-local signature memoization
58. project-cache-refresh: 8566 ms; 5 modules / 36 decls; refresh five changed local modules over the completed Mathlib cache
59. project-cache-marker-hit: 92 ms; 16 modules / 0 decls; internal elapsed time for the next cache command
60. distinct-query-final: 150 ms; 16 modules / 10 decls; median new-process wall time across four distinct cached declarations
61. pp-batch-paired: 21415 ms; 64 modules / 2310 decls; warm filesystem baseline with four-module batch barriers
62. pp-worker-pool-paired: 20180 ms; 64 modules / 2310 decls; warm filesystem sustained four-worker queue with byte-identical sidecars
